# Global Instructions

## Teammate Pane Cleanup

After all agents have shut down and `TeamDelete` succeeds, close lingering iTerm2 panes by their unique ID (from the team config's `tmuxPaneId` field). Do NOT use `write text "exit"` — the shell may already be dead. Instead use:

```applescript
tell application "iTerm2"
    tell current window
        repeat with aTab in tabs
            repeat with aSession in sessions of aTab
                if unique ID of aSession is "<PANE_ID>" then
                    tell aSession to close
                end if
            end repeat
        end repeat
    end tell
end tell
```
